hints: two-wire (SPI-like) data: start frame 32 zero bits; per LED '111' + 5-bit brightness, then 8 bit blue, green, red, MSB first; end frame 32 one bits (section 10.1)
frame rate = 1 / ((64 + 32 × LEDs) × CKI period) – 1024 LEDs at 1 MHz give 30 frames/s (section 10.2)
5-bit current gain 0 … 18 mA; for heat the data sheet recommends at most level 22 (12.2 mA), levels 23–32 not (section 10.5)

application circuit (section 11, p. 10): protective series resistors R1/R2 on the signal lines at the chain's input and output must be fitted, 20 Ω … 2 kΩ, usually about 500 Ω; the decoupling capacitor at every LED should not be omitted (value not given)

mechanical dimensions and pin function, section 4–5, p. 4: 1 SDI, 2 CKI, 3 GND, 4 VDD, 5 CKO, 6 SDO; top view 4/5/6 on the left from the top, 3/2/1 on the right from the top
IC limit parameter (Ta 25 °C), section 7, p. 5: Topt −40 … +80 °C, Tstg −40 … +80 °C, ESD 2 kV HBM; its VDD row reads −0.3 … VDD + 0.3 V
